$comment: The initial profile is exact and proposed. This contract does not claim human policy activation or install enforcement. Changed semantics require a new reviewed profile version.

activation.const: explicit separate human ratification and reviewed consumer adoption; no enforcement installed

const: ratchet/enforce only after explicit mature scoped adoption

clock.const: explicit as_of UTC; reject future observations

incomplete_inventory.const: unknown freshness unless a witnessed material event or deadline proves stale

invalidation.const: preserve historical decision; expose stale effective posture without rewriting source

materiality.const: only explicit scoped sourced events following the represented assessment; routine revision differences are independent

valid_until.const: optional explicit source deadline; stale only after this deadline

human_evidence.const: Raw record fields only declare claims. Separate trusted human-source context must bind exact canonical statement, scope, revisions and assessment digest. No context means unverified, never ratified.

const: replacing ADRs, audits, conformance, CI, health or release readiness

aether.const: portable full review/assessment contract, prompts, templates and read-only authoring skill

hygiene.const: applicability, governance, freshness and human-authority semantics

observatory.const: privacy-safe read models and queries; preserves source claims versus verified authority

pace.const: reviewed adoption proposals; no automatic authority or enforcement

relay.const: bounded evidence capture, verification, artifacts and repository presentation

repository.const: canonical facts, public admission, human governance sources and final publication

title: Proposed architecture-coherence policy alpha.1
